race.comment: The feature of the day is the 60K Carnarvon Cup over 2000m. PHAROAH SHOW (4) finished a solid fourth in the lead-up to this race here nearly 2 weeks ago over 1750m. He has a nice jockey upgrade with Kate Pateman in the saddle, and if she can find a spot from a wide gate, then they will go close to taking this out. KINGS SICARIO (3) let down strongly to win the Broome Cup 4 weeks ago, making it a hat-trick of wins in the process. He has winning form on the track, and though he is up 4kg in weight, he can repeat the dose. ZADAR ROCK (1) was finishing just as quickly as the second pick when finishing third behind that runner in the same race last time out. He won the Roebourne Cup late last season and can add this trophy to his cabinet as well. DYNAMIC ONE (2) was far too strong in the Mt Newman Cup 3 weeks ago, and if he can carry that form through, then he is a top 4 hope here. HARD QUESTIONS (8) was a touch plain here last start, but he was probably waiting for this race. Keep safe.
